C-FIX-012-RENDER-CURSOR-GUARD.Name: Render blocks safely while the cursor has no start point
C-FIX-012-RENDER-CURSOR-GUARD.Summary: Complete the attributed FIX-012 repair at the next renderer boundary: selector construction must remain valid when accumulated editor commands leave no active block and the current cursor has no start point.
C-FIX-012-RENDER-CURSOR-GUARD.Problem: After the active-block ancestry repair, the reduced Guide-cycle case passes but the complete registry walk still reaches tabs.cycleForward with an empty active-block chain and cursor.start absent. StateRender.getSelector then reads cursor.start.key and aborts the tab render.
C-FIX-012-RENDER-CURSOR-GUARD.ApprovalBasis: This is a narrow failing-evidence companion to the owner-approved C-FIX-012-TAB-CYCLE-RENDER work. StateRender was not in the earlier companion's observed write scope, so a separate approved bundle preserves immutable-plan discipline.

Goals.Goal: Build selectors when cursor or cursor.start is absent.
Keep active selector behavior unchanged whenever a valid cursor start or active block exists.
Make the exact full registry walk warning-clean.

Constraints.Constraint: Normalize only selector activity detection; do not synthesize cursor state, swallow render exceptions, or alter block trees.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No tab UX redesign, unrelated renderer hardening, Windows/Linux work, release or publication.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: getSelector does not throw for null cursor or a cursor without start.
A matching valid cursor start still adds the active class.
The complete affordance registry walk emits no tabs.cycleForward warning.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Direct missing-cursor selector fixtures plus the complete browser command walk.
